up: Retrieve activity data for assay CHEMBL3885882. Return canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Filter for exact activity measurements only (standard_relation = '=').
sql: SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays aas JOIN activities a ON aas.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE aas.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3885882' AND a.standard_relation = '='
